top5.title: CNIL closes France Travail injunction after security controls were implemented
top5.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-10-08

evidence.sourceTitle: Clôture de l’injonction prononcée à l’encontre de FRANCE TRAVAIL
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: CNIL closed its injunction after France Travail demonstrated stronger passwords, multi-factor authentication for adviser accounts, active log monitoring and access limited to job-related data. The authority did not apply the daily penalty. The case shows remediation closure tied to implemented measures, rather than a policy commitment alone.

sourceDateVerification.reason: CNIL's primary page displays 8 October 2026 beneath the title. Its page date was checked directly.

top5.title: Irish DPC orders DPIAs and controls after children’s paper-record failings

evidence.sourceTitle: Data Protection Commission Publishes Final Decision Following Inquiry into the Children’s Health Ireland (‘CHI’)
evidence.significance: The DPC published notice of its final decision on 1 October; the decision was notified to CHI on 10 September. It reprimanded CHI at Tallaght, ordered two DPIAs finalised and sent within four weeks, and required implementation of their identified measures. The full written decision will follow.

top5.title: CNIL turns e-invoicing platforms into a data-role and retention test
top5.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-09-10

evidence.sourceTitle: Facturation électronique : quels enjeux pour la protection des données personnelles ?
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: CNIL's guidance accompanies the live French e-invoicing reform and sets out the practical boundary between controller and processor, the need for appropriate contracts, data minimisation, retention and platform traceability. For affected firms, the implementation question is whether the chosen platform's data use, access controls and audit record match the intended operating role.
